author: GamingBolt
description: NBA 2K27 doesn’t reinvent the franchise as much as it could, but its noticeable gameplay tweaks, complemented by a surprisingly deep MyCareer and a streamlined MyTeam mode, make it about as good as this version of the franchise has been in some time.
title: NBA 2K27 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Metal Gear Solid 5: The Phantom Pain has been around for a while. It might even get a new lease of life if Konami decides to bring out a version of it as part of a future Master Collection. But why hasn’t a game as iconic as this one had many rivals to match what it offers more than a decade after its release? What makes MGSV so unique?

We’ve got answers to those questions, and some very interesting arguments to back them up. If you’re a new fan to the franchise or a seasoned operative and a master at CQC, this title will definitely make you appreciate a game that might have been divisive, but is no less great because of it.
title: It's Been 11 Years, Why Has Nobody Made Another Metal Gear Solid 5?

author: GamingBolt
description:
EA Sports FC 27 invites you back to the digital pitch. This year’s iteration giving you greater control over attacking and defending through more precise mechanics, expressive gameplay, and rewards for highly skilled play. 

From manual tackling and ball delivery, to new ways to find and attack space, FC 27 hopes its community-driven innovations bring the truest-to-life footballing sim the series has ever delivered. Oh, and there’s an all-new, street-level social hub, but we’ll get to that. So, let’s kick off: here’s 15 things you need to know about FC 27.
title: EA Sports FC 27 - 15 NEW Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
